Tokyo has five Christmas markets this December. Two are free to walk into, two give you a mug only if you buy ahead, and one sits by Yokohama's harbour. Here's which one fits your evening 👇

🎯 Guess which one costs nothing to enter, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-christmas-markets-2026

We checked every date, hour and price on the official pages before writing this.

🎄 THE FIVE MARKETS

1️⃣ Roppongi Hills, free. The 20th edition, about ten stalls led by Käthe Wohlfahrt's German ornaments. 21 Nov–25 Dec, 11:00–21:00, one minute from Roppongi Station.

2️⃣ Skytree Town, no ticket listed. Fifteen huts on the 4th floor, drinks in boot-shaped mugs, snowman milk tea. 5 Nov–25 Dec. Our family pick.

3️⃣ Tokyo Christmas Market, Shin-Toyosu. By the water, from 20 November. ¥1,000 on weekdays, ¥1,500 at weekends.

4️⃣ Tokyo Christmas Market, Shiba Park. Under the trees by Onarimon, from 4 December. Same prices, and it stays open until 22:00.

5️⃣ Yokohama Red Brick. An 11 m live tree and a tunnel of lights, entry from ¥500.

📅 WORTH KNOWING

On 24 and 25 December the Tokyo Christmas Market costs ¥2,000 per adult. All five close on the 25th.

Our take: Roppongi Hills if you only have an hour, Shiba Park for the full German-market night.
